description: Defines types, enums, structs, constants, and function prototypes for DRM (Digital Rights Management) support in the Starboard platform, including session request types, status codes, key statuses, sample info, and callback mechanisms.

methods.name: SbDrmCreateSystem
methods.description: Creates a new DRM system instance with specified callbacks and key system string.

methods.name: SbDrmGenerateSessionUpdateRequest
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a session update request payload based on initialization data.

methods.name: SbDrmUpdateSession
methods.description: Updates a DRM session with license key data from server response.

methods.name: SbDrmCloseSession
methods.description: Closes and clears resources for a specified DRM session.

methods.name: SbDrmUpdateServerCertificate
methods.description: Updates the server certificate for the DRM system.

methods.name: SbDrmGetMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves metrics data from the DRM system.

methods.name: SbDrmDestroySystem
methods.description: Destroys the DRM system instance, cleaning up resources.
